scope: Step 06 resource certification against the locally built ChatGPT Sites Worker preview; not the public review deployment.

entries.title: Marketing CTA looked enabled but performed no action
entries.expected: The CTA should call a connected host action or be visibly and accessibly disabled until one is provided.
entries.actual: The resource rendered an enabled button with no click handler or feedback.
reproduction: Open /resources/marketing-nav-cta/.
Focus Start Free and press Enter; no navigation or state change occurs.
entries.rootCause: MarketingNavCta declared no action prop and rendered an unconditional button; the resource preview host could not supply a meaningful demo action.

entries.title: Pricing plan buttons had no selection behavior
entries.expected: Each plan action should report its selected plan, or be disabled with an explanation until connected.
entries.actual: All three enabled Get Started buttons had no handler or visible feedback.
reproduction: Open /resources/pricing-three-tier/.
Focus the first Get Started button and press Enter; no state change occurs.
entries.rootCause: PricingThreeTier rendered three static buttons without an onSelectPlan integration contract.

entries.title: Create New Project action was a dead control
entries.expected: The control should invoke project creation or be disabled with a clear explanation until connected.
entries.actual: The enabled button did not invoke an action or change visible state.
reproduction: Open /resources/empty-workspace/.
Focus Create New Project and press Enter; nothing happens.
entries.rootCause: EmptyWorkspace exposed no host callback and rendered the action unconditionally enabled.

entries.title: Magnetic button advertised a click action but only moved on hover
entries.expected: A button should perform a host action or be disabled with an explanation until connected.
entries.actual: The control reacted to pointer movement but keyboard/click activation produced no action or feedback.
reproduction: Open /resources/magnetic-button/.
Focus the button and press Enter; it remains unchanged.
entries.rootCause: MagneticButton implemented only pointer tracking and omitted a click callback contract.

entries.title: Retry Operation did not reach the preview host
entries.expected: The preview should report a retry example, and consumers without a retry operation should see a disabled control.
entries.actual: ErrorState accepted onRetry, but PreviewHost did not supply it, leaving an enabled inert button.
reproduction: Open /resources/error-state/.
Activate Retry Operation; there is no visible response.
entries.rootCause: The preview host mapped several generic example callbacks but omitted the existing onRetry prop.

entries.title: Documentation reading column overflowed the mobile preview
entries.expected: The navigation, reading column and optional page index should stack within the available preview width.
entries.actual: The fixed 224px sidebar plus 80px main padding forced the reading column past the 322px iframe viewport (376px scroll width).
reproduction: Open /resources/documentation-shell/ at 390x844.
Inspect the embedded preview; the main heading and text are clipped horizontally.
entries.rootCause: The shell used fixed desktop flex widths and large padding without a container-responsive stacking rule.

entries.title: Floating navigation exceeded the mobile preview width
entries.expected: The pill navigation should wrap and remain inside the preview viewport.
entries.actual: The non-wrapping navigation measured 347px against a 322px iframe viewport.
reproduction: Open /resources/floating-nav/ at 390x844.
Inspect the embedded preview; the navigation pill extends beyond its viewport.
entries.rootCause: The pill used a single-row inline flex layout with fixed gaps and horizontal padding.

entries.title: Long webhook URL clipped its status on mobile
entries.expected: The endpoint URL and status should reflow into a readable vertical row at narrow widths.
entries.actual: The 341px resource content exceeded a 322px iframe viewport and clipped the endpoint/status row.
reproduction: Open /resources/webhook-management/ at 390x844.
Inspect the embedded preview; the URL and 200 OK status are clipped.
entries.rootCause: A non-wrapping flex row contained a long unbreakable endpoint URL and a status badge.

entries.title: Resource detail title markup corrupted the desktop page layout
entries.expected: The title should remain in the document head and the resource heading, tag list, preview and inspector should render as separate layout regions.
entries.actual: Astro split the interpolated title at the slug expression, placing the closing title/head tags before the trailing text. The browser then parsed resource-header children incorrectly and reduced the preview to 237px at 1280px.
reproduction: Open /resources/ai-prompt-hero/ at 1280x900.
Inspect the document title and resource preview; the title was truncated, the detail DOM was misnested and the preview was too narrow.
entries.rootCause: The Astro template split one title string across multiple text/interpolation segments containing parentheses. The compiler hoisted closing head markup between those segments, corrupting all following body markup.
entries.remediation: Render each resource document title as one Astro expression; align both resource-detail routes on the same semantic header and min-width-safe responsive grid.

entries.title: AI activity rows overflowed the compact preview
entries.expected: Event metadata and action copy should wrap within the preview without horizontal scrolling.
entries.actual: Long event actions and agent names exceeded the 360px preview width.
entries.rootCause: The event row reserved a single non-wrapping horizontal line for timestamp, agent badge and action text.
entries.remediation: Allow row metadata to wrap and give the action copy a full-width row at compact widths.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The initial failing run reported this resource; its ephemeral before screenshot was not retained.

entries.title: AI prompt hero content exceeded its narrow preview
entries.expected: The hero heading, prompt input, engine label and preset chips should fit and wrap within the preview.
entries.actual: The preview document was 306px wide inside a 292px viewport at 360px; at 1280px and 1440px outer widths the inner preview also exceeded its 237px viewport.
entries.rootCause: The centered flex content used intrinsic-width children and fixed horizontal padding; chips and the engine row could not shrink or wrap within the iframe.
entries.remediation: Make the content column full-width and min-width-safe, wrap long heading and helper text, and allow prompt controls and preset chips to wrap.

entries.title: Citation paths forced a source card wider than the preview
entries.expected: Citation title, file path, and quote should wrap inside each source card.
entries.actual: The source title/path row exceeded the 360px preview width.
entries.rootCause: A fixed justify-between row kept the citation title and long path on one line.
entries.remediation: Allow the title and path to wrap, break long paths, and keep only the verification status unshrunk.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The initial failing run reported this resource; its ephemeral before screenshot was not retained.

entries.title: Breadcrumb header controls overflowed at phone width
entries.expected: Breadcrumbs and actions should wrap into readable rows within the viewport.
entries.actual: The breadcrumb trail and action controls occupied one fixed row and extended past the preview.
entries.rootCause: The header used a fixed-height, single-line flex layout with fixed horizontal padding.
entries.remediation: Use a minimum height, compact padding and wrapping layout for both breadcrumb items and action controls.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The initial failing run reported this resource; its ephemeral before screenshot was not retained.

entries.title: Counter typography row exceeded the compact preview width

entries.actual: The large counter value, unit and delta were forced into one row at 360px.
entries.rootCause: A non-wrapping baseline flex row combined the large numeric display with the unit and delta label.
entries.remediation: Allow the value and unit row to wrap and place the delta on its own line at compact widths.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The initial failing run reported this resource; its ephemeral before screenshot was not retained.

entries.title: Floating assistant dialog exceeded its compact preview

entries.remediation: Use a full-width wrapper capped at the existing 20rem maximum and let the dialog inherit the available width.

entries.title: AI activity action text was unreadably narrow on mobile

entries.rootCause: After the row was made wrapping, its action flex item could still shrink beside timestamp and agent metadata.

entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The failing state is captured by the assertion output; after screenshot shows the corrected row.

entries.title: Advanced data table rendered an empty body without an empty-state message
entries.expected: An empty dataset should produce a clear, accessible explanation in the table body.

Observe that the table body has no rows and no status message.
entries.rootCause: The resource rendered only mapped records and had no zero-row or zero-filter-match state.
entries.remediation: Render a polite live status for both empty input and filters that return no matches; add a real-browser state regression.

entries.title: Kanban board rendered no guidance when it had no columns

Set the live preview columns prop to an empty array.
Observe that the board has no lanes and no status message.
entries.rootCause: The board mapped its columns directly and provided no zero-column state.
entries.remediation: Render a polite, responsive empty-state explanation and cover it with a real-browser state regression.

entries.title: Marketing CTA preview header overflowed at narrow width in Linux Chromium
entries.expected: The brand, navigation links and CTA should reflow inside the isolated preview at compact widths.
entries.actual: CI measured the 292px preview document at 316px and 321px. The local Windows browser did not reproduce the font-metric-sensitive overflow until the failing Linux CI report was reviewed.
reproduction: Run the Sites Worker catalogue and Gold browser matrices in Linux Chromium.
Open /resources/marketing-nav-cta/ at a 360px outer viewport.
Inspect the 292px iframe document; the header forces content beyond its right edge.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The failing CI log and DOM geometry are preserved in audit/evidence/step-06/before/marketing-nav-cta-ci-failure.md; the workflow did not retain a baseline screenshot.
entries.rootCause: The header and navigation used a single horizontal flex row with desktop gaps and padding, so Linux font metrics made the combined intrinsic width exceed the narrow iframe.
entries.remediation: Allow the brand and navigation groups to wrap within the preview, reduce compact CTA padding, and test document width and item overlap at 360px and 390px in browser.

entries.title: Timeline showed a blank panel when there were no events
entries.expected: An empty event list should explain that there is no activity yet.
entries.actual: After passing an empty events array, the title remained but the event area was blank with no accessible status.
reproduction: Open /resources/timeline/ at 360x844.
Set the live preview events prop to an empty array.
Observe that the timeline body contains no status or guidance.
entries.rootCause: Timeline mapped events directly and had no zero-event rendering branch.
entries.remediation: Render a polite empty-state status when the event list is empty and cover both empty and long event lists in a browser regression.

entries.title: Dashboard KPI grid showed no explanation when there were no cards
entries.expected: An empty metrics array should explain that no metrics are available yet.
entries.actual: An empty cards array left the dashboard title over an empty content area with no accessible status.
reproduction: Open /resources/dashboard-kpi-grid/ at 360x844.
Set the live preview cards prop to an empty array.
Observe that the metrics region is blank.
entries.rootCause: The KPI grid mapped cards directly and had no zero-card state.
entries.remediation: Render a polite empty-state status when the card list is empty and exercise empty and long, large datasets in a browser regression.

entries.title: Empty notification centre left an enabled action with no result
entries.expected: With no notifications, the preview should show an empty-state message and disable Mark all as read.
entries.actual: The empty notification list had no status message. Mark all as read remained enabled and produced no visible result.
reproduction: Open /resources/notification-centre/ at 360x844.
Set the preview events prop to an empty array.
Inspect the blank list and activate Mark all as read.
entries.rootCause: The component had no zero-item state or unread-item guard for the action.
entries.remediation: Show an accessible empty state and disable the action when there are no unread notifications.

entries.title: Notification centre ignored event data updates after mount
entries.expected: New event props should replace stale preview data and render the supplied notifications.
entries.actual: After an empty list was shown, updating events with 50 notifications did not render the final supplied event.
reproduction: Open /resources/notification-centre/ at 360x844.
Set events to an empty array, then update events with 50 notifications.
Look for the 50th supplied notification; it does not appear.
entries.rootCause: The events prop was read only by the useState initializer, so later host updates did not synchronize the local list.
entries.remediation: Synchronize local read-state records when the events input changes, then verify incoming data and keyboard interaction through the isolated preview.

entries.title: Mark all as read gave no accessible confirmation
entries.expected: Marking unread notifications should announce how many were updated and disable the completed action.
entries.actual: The original action updated local read styling silently; there was no status region or confirmation for keyboard and assistive-technology users.
reproduction: Open /resources/notification-centre/ at 360x844 with unread notifications.
Focus Mark all as read and press Enter.
Observe that no status announces the completed update.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The original run retained the empty-state baseline and failing role=status assertion; it did not retain an after-click screenshot from the pre-fix bundle.
entries.rootCause: The action only changed item styling and did not set or render an accessible result message.
entries.remediation: Announce the updated notification count in a polite live status and disable the action when no unread item remains.

entries.title: Empty time-series chart displayed a false zero reading
entries.expected: An empty dataset should report that no data is available and avoid presenting a numeric reading.
entries.actual: With data set to an empty array, the chart still showed axes and a 0 req/s metric without an empty-state message.
reproduction: Open /resources/time-series-chart/ at 360x844.
Set the preview data prop to an empty array.
Observe the zero metric and chart axes despite there being no samples.
entries.rootCause: The metric fell back to zero when there was no final point, and the renderer did not distinguish empty data from valid zero-valued data.
entries.remediation: Render an accessible no-data state, omit the numeric metric and axes for an empty array, and test recovery when data arrives.

entries.remediation: Move the command field to a full-width row at compact breakpoints, permit the header height to grow, and assert the responsive matrix remains within the iframe.

entries.remediation: Allow the tab row to wrap and use compact horizontal button padding at small widths; capture 360px and desktop browser evidence.

entries.title: Gradient headline container overflowed in Linux Chromium at 360px
entries.expected: The expressive headline and container padding should adapt to the 292px preview without widening its document.
entries.actual: Linux CI measured a 304px preview document inside a 292px frame.
reproduction: Run the Sites Worker catalogue matrix in Linux Chromium.
Open /resources/gradient-accent-text/ at a 360px outer viewport.
Inspect the headline and isolated preview width.
entries.baselineScreenshotStatus: The failing Linux CI log preserved document/frame width and DOM ancestor geometry; the workflow did not upload screenshots or traces.
entries.rootCause: The component retained 32px padding and a 30px heading at the preview width, leaving too little room for its longer headline words.
entries.remediation: Reduce compact-width padding and heading size, allow long headline words to wrap, and certify the 360px resource matrix.

entries.title: Empty Kanban state suggested unavailable add actions
entries.expected: The empty board should state its condition without implying the preview can add columns or tasks.
entries.actual: The status said "Add a column or task to get started" although the resource exposes no add controls.
reproduction: Open /resources/kanban-board/ at 360x844.
Set columns to an empty array in the preview.
Read the empty status and inspect available controls; there is no add action.
entries.rootCause: The empty-state copy described add functionality that the standalone resource does not implement.
entries.remediation: Use a factual empty-state status and assert the empty preview does not promise absent actions.

entries.title: Kanban sample tasks displayed fabricated Tessellate catalogue counts
entries.expected: The sample board should use representative tasks without asserting unsupported product totals.
entries.actual: Default tasks claimed "Scale 56 application blocks", "72 Marketing sections verified" and "44 Primitives complete".
reproduction: Open /resources/kanban-board/ at 360x844.
Inspect the default task cards.
Observe the three unsubstantiated catalogue totals.
entries.rootCause: The default demo fixture embedded hard-coded product counts in task text.
entries.remediation: Replace fabricated totals with representative onboarding tasks and add browser assertions against the false claims.

entries.title: Bar chart presented illustrative sign-up totals as actual data
entries.expected: A static preview should clearly identify its values as illustrative sample data.
entries.actual: The preview showed a daily conversion chart and total with no sample disclosure, implying that the figures described real activity.
reproduction: Open /resources/bar-chart/ at 360x844.
Inspect the chart title, explanatory copy, and summary values.
The before capture shows the original misleading copy; the updated preview must disclose illustrative sample data.
entries.rootCause: The component bundled static example values under operational copy and labeled their sum as a live total.
entries.remediation: Use sample-specific titles and label bundled values as illustrative sample data, without implying a live source.

entries.title: Nocturne muted text fell below WCAG contrast across 15 Gold resources
entries.expected: Muted text in Nocturne resources must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast against its rendered surface.
entries.actual: Axe reported 23 contrast violations in Nocturne variants across 15 Gold resources. Reused muted ink was #62666F on dark surfaces at 3.05:1 to 3.38:1.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=ai-prompt-composer&variant=nocturne at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: Global muted ink changed for .dark but not for data-resource-variant="nocturne". During remediation, FadeUpReveal also required its replay control to sit on a matching dark surface.
entries.remediation: Set the Nocturne muted ink tokens on the resource-variant scope and give the fade-up replay control a matching dark surface. Axe now reports zero violations across all Gold resources and variants.

entries.title: AI research confidence badge had insufficient contrast on light surfaces
entries.expected: The confidence badge text must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast against its badge background.
entries.actual: Axe measured 2.34:1 for #00BC7D on #ECFDF5 in Quiet and Expressive variants.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=ai-research-answer&variant=quiet at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: The green confidence color was chosen without validating contrast on the pale green badge.
entries.remediation: Use a darker green for light variants and a lighter green for Nocturne. The 120-variant Axe matrix now passes.

entries.title: Feature matrix status text fell below WCAG contrast on light surfaces
entries.expected: Status values in the feature matrix must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast.
entries.actual: Axe measured 3.65:1 for #009966 on white and 3.32:1 on the Expressive surface across 16 cells in each affected variant.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=feature-matrix&variant=quiet at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: The matrix reused emerald-600 text color that was too light for normal-size text.
entries.remediation: Use emerald-800 on light surfaces and emerald-300 on Nocturne. The 120-variant Axe matrix now passes.

entries.title: Error-state heading fell below WCAG contrast on its expressive background
entries.expected: The error heading must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast against the blush surface.
entries.actual: Axe measured 4.31:1 for #E7000B on #F9F2F0.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=error-state&variant=expressive at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: The heading used red-600 on a lightly tinted red surface.
entries.remediation: Use red-700 on light variants while retaining red-400 on Nocturne. The 120-variant Axe matrix now passes.

entries.title: Recommended pricing badge had insufficient contrast in all variants
entries.expected: The Recommended badge must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast in Quiet, Expressive and Nocturne.
entries.actual: Axe measured 3.31:1 on light badges and 4.17:1 in Nocturne.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=pricing-three-tier&variant=nocturne at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: The badge used emerald-600 for every surface, including its dark Nocturne background.
entries.remediation: Use emerald-800 on light surfaces and emerald-300 on Nocturne. The 120-variant Axe matrix now passes.

entries.title: Input resource preview rendered a field without an accessible name
entries.expected: The Gold Input preview must expose a programmatic label in all three variants.
entries.actual: Axe reported a critical form-label violation in Quiet, Expressive and Nocturne. The preview showed only an empty input.
reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=input&variant=quiet at 1440x900.
Run the Gold-resource Axe matrix with WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Compare the retained before and after captures.
entries.rootCause: The manifest supplied no preview props, so PreviewHost rendered Input without its optional label.
entries.remediation: Provide a sample label and placeholder in preview defaultProps. The browser Axe matrix now finds an accessible name in every variant.
